left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Persons diagnosed with pharyngeal gonorrhea  [OR] or gonococcal urethritis  [AND] who are undergoing pharyngeal gonorrhea testing, [AND]  who are not yet treated

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Age less than 16 years
  -  Receipt of antibiotics in ≤30 days
  -  Known allergy to aztreonam
  -  History of renal disease (including diagnosis of solitary kidney, chronic renal insufficiency, [OR]  renal cell carcinoma etc

left.raw_text:
)
  -  Concurrent infection with syphilis  [OR] or chlamydia
  -  Pregnancy  [OR] and/or nursing
  -  Unable to return for a follow-up visit 4-7 days (+/- 1 day)
